hashConvention.source: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after optional BOM removal and CRLF/CR to LF normalization; no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: Exact Tree-sitter declaration/expression byte span including body and excluding preceding XML comments/trailing whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Declaration start through body/accessor-list start with trailing whitespace removed; for lambda expressions this includes authored parameter/arrow tokens before the body.
hashConvention.body: Exact body/block/arrow-expression/accessor-list bytes. Auto-property accessor syntax is hashed but generated get/set methods are not separate authored callables.

variables.S: Catalog slot count, at most 4096 under the Core source reader.
variables.Q: Pending preview requests in the serialized browser task chain; no fixed admission-count cap.
variables.C: Pending source-close requests; no fixed admission-count cap.
variables.V/I: Vertices/indices in the selected normalized frame. Current Shadowkey adapter unrolls triangle corners and admits one static mesh/material/image.
variables.P: Owned encoded PNG bytes and decoded pixels for the selected skin; source/normalization costs are reviewed by the separate Core receipt.
variables.L: Displayed path/name/diagnostic text length; formatting and logging may process O(L) text.
variables.R: Total realized framework items/bindings affected by list/gallery/tree clearing; framework rendering/layout costs are not asserted constant.
variables.W: Predecessor completion, cancellation callbacks, I/O, shared preparation, GPU retirement and dispatcher scheduling. Wall-clock wait has no finite deadline guarantee.
variables.D: Selected Core catalog.Prepare work, including record parse, normalization and PNG encoding.
variables.N: Shared NativeScenePresenter preparation/adoption/clear/disposal work at the pinned contract; not a local O(1) operation.
variables.resourceBudgetMeaning: Numerical payload allowances below exclude managed headers, retained source/evaluator graphs, codec scratch, descriptors, swap chains, driver storage and unrelated application viewers.

constant.time: O(1) local fixed-size state/reference work; called framework callbacks are separate.

activity.time: O(1) local forwarding; delegated Shared activity/capture cancellation is not measured.
activity.space: O(1) local state; retains the existing presenter/camera.

configure.time: Fixed number of owner/control constructions and bindings; delegated Shared localization/inspection setup and framework layout are separate.
configure.space: O(1) application owner references plus Shared retained controls/bindings; no catalog decode or GLB serialization.

queue.time: O(1) local enqueue/publication; synchronous cancellation invokes registered predecessor callbacks whose cost is delegated.
queue.space: O(1) task/closure/token registration per request; O(Q) pending request state globally.

select.time: O(1) local selection work plus O(R) framework clear/rebinding, O(L) status formatting and queued Core OpenAsync work.
select.space: O(1) local references per request; O(S) catalog/UI references and bounded Core input copies are delegated.

prepare.time: O(1) identity/options/camera capture plus O(L) status formatting and enqueue. Actual D is off-thread and serialized.
prepare.space: O(1) immutable selection, retained camera reference and closure per request.

adopt.time: D + selected-scene bounds measurement + N; fixed local identity/range/status steps. Includes W; not bounded by a timeout.
adopt.space: Selected scene/image ownership plus bounded pose/preparation payloads and O(1) local state; predecessor native state is cleared before replacement work.

run.time: Predecessor W + N(clear) + current callback cost, or cancellation cleanup. Only one request body prepares/adopts at a time.
run.space: O(1) state per queued request, O(Q) chain globally; callbacks may retain catalog, snapshot, selection and camera references until settlement.

clear.time: O(R) control reset + pending-chain W + N(clear); captured cancellation callbacks are additional delegated work.
clear.space: O(1) local captured identities; source ownership is retained until successful native clearing.

dispose.time: Fixed local stages plus settling C/Q chains, cancellation callbacks, N(dispose) and existing owner retirement. W has no timeout guarantee.
dispose.space: O(1) application stage/error slots, excluding original exception objects, delegated owners and existing pending chains.

status.time: O(L) diagnostic/status formatting and delegated logging or localization-binding refresh.
status.space: O(L) formatted text/diagnostic retention where allocated.

guard.time: O(1) exact reference/scalar/type checks, or exception construction on rejection.

measure.time: For this admitted static, one-node mesh: O(V + I) validation/rest sampling/indexed bounds work, plus fixed structural checks. Shared general scene algorithms are not re-reviewed here.
measure.space: O(V) pose numeric scratch plus source/evaluator/presentation bookkeeping. Explicit pose bank payload allowance is 128 MiB; it is not a total heap cap.

camera.time: O(1) fixed Vector3/scalar shared camera mathematics.
camera.space: O(1) camera/lens/limit objects; original source basis and units remain unchanged.

attach_delta.time: O(1) added disposed pre-admission guard; inherited attach/lease/tree/gallery costs remain outside this delta bound.
attach_delta.space: O(1) added guard; inherited attached source/thumbnail ownership unchanged.

legacy_selection_delta.time: O(1) added branch plus SelectShadowkeyPack cost; inherited sibling gallery/media/map/sky work remains outside this delta bound.
legacy_selection_delta.space: O(1) added branch; downstream preview/catalog ownership described separately.

source_close_start.time: O(1) generation/gate/result publication; one observed queued close runs after its predecessor.
source_close_start.space: O(1) task/completion state per close, O(C) pending close chain globally.

source_close_run.time: Predecessor W + ClearShadowkeySourceAsync + inherited source/UI/media cleanup. Serial execution prevents an older close touching a new source.
source_close_run.space: O(1) close continuation state plus inherited control/owner cleanup; old source fields remain retained when native clear fails.

constructor_delta.time: Fixed added WindowWorkflowServices/Direct3D12Graphics/preview-owner setup; inherited InitializeComponent and startup work is outside the delta bound.
constructor_delta.space: One window graphics owner and workflow-services object plus configure-category Shared controls/bindings.

navigation_delta.time: O(1) added activity forwarding; inherited navigation/tree/map/view switching is outside the delta bound.
navigation_delta.space: O(1) added state; retained native presentation is not rebuilt on navigation.

close_window.time: Await existing shutdown W, then fixed proof/status/Close checks. Failed native retirement retains the window; no disposal retry.
close_window.space: O(1) local state plus prerequisites intentionally retained on failure.

publish_dispose.time: O(1) prepublication and idempotent repeated-call lookup; the one observed disposal continuation delegates retirement.
publish_dispose.space: One retained task/completion pair per control instance; repeated callers do not add cleanup tasks.

reset.time: Fixed property assignments plus O(R) framework list/control clearing and binding work; no catalog decode is requested by this method.
reset.space: O(1) local state; drops retained catalog/selection/camera references without copying source payloads.

catalog_open.time: Core OpenAsync bounded archive/VFS read and catalog parse cost, then fixed identity checks plus O(R) list binding; see the separate Core receipt.
catalog_open.space: Detached bounded pack/index/names data and O(S) entry references plus O(1) callback state; Core owns the temporary read lease.

core_prepare.time: D: synchronous selected-record parse and existing normalization/PNG work, executed in Task.Run; no UI/native adoption occurs inside this worker callback.
core_prepare.space: Core-owned parsed record and selected normalized scene/image storage; see the Core source receipt for bounded input and output amplification.

catalog.authority: Core ShadowkeyPackPreviewSource; see separate Core source receipt. The UI does not copy payloads per list row or open one file per synthetic slot.

ui.queueMeaning: Bodies are serialized, but canceled pending continuations are not removed from the chain. Queue memory is O(Q+C) plus referenced catalogs/scenes and delegated work; no total process ceiling is claimed.

resourceBounds.notIncluded: These independent payload allowances are not a process-memory cap. Source/evaluator graphs, managed headers, framework item realization, PNG scratch, descriptors, swap-chain/driver allocation, logging and other viewers remain outside them.

lifecycleReview: All mutation/adoption and native retirement use the owning UI synchronization context. Task.Run is limited to detached catalog.Prepare and exact-document measurement.

Opening acquires a Core read lease; the browser retains its source lease through native clearing. Shared acquires the exact catalog.Snapshot for adopted input; no unrelated current source is substituted.
Source, generation, request revision, catalog reference, immutable selection reference and slot are checked before asynchronous results may publish.
Source-close tasks publish before callbacks and serialize field access. Every caller increments generation synchronously; the existing attachment check rejects earlier concurrent callers.
The closing gate blocks tree/export-check/slot/option and late-failure admission. Clear captures the exact cancellation/task owners; it cannot dispose a replacement CTS.
Disposed attachment is rejected before lease acquisition and before appending the close chain. Existing Explore source gate drains its open operation before browser disposal.
Browser and Explore disposal publish one retained completion before callbacks. Independent stages ensure synchronous unrelated cleanup errors do not skip shared native retirement.

Failed native clearing retains old source fields. A later successful presenter disposal permits source release without retrying failed Shared disposal; errors remain aggregated. Failed presenter/graphics retirement keeps source/graphics/localization/HWND prerequisites.

Same-slot frame/skin/key recomposition captures Shared camera before cancellation. A distinct catalog/slot resets framing. Navigation changes presentation activity without recreating the source or inventing playback.

Selecting models.huge cancels/hides legacy mesh; existing audio/video/map handling hides incompatible sibling previews and cancels sky/video work. Tree nodes and checked export identities remain original VFS entries.
Unrepresented animation timing stays declined by Core; the helper also rejects unexpected scene animation tracks. Ready status means adopted, not actual frame acknowledgement.
The pinned Shared presenter returns its same terminal failed disposal task on repeat calls. No automatic release retry, second presenter or reconstructed native owner is claimed as recovery.
